verdict.rationale: Docs confirm API access via tokens (dev/production) issued under Account Settings → Security, and old community comments mention two-factor authentication support, but there is no first-party documentation of scoped/permissioned API credentials or IP allowlisting for API access, and a historical breach report raises concerns about account security practices. missing for 10: documented scoped API credential permissions, IP allowlisting for API access, and current first-party 2FA documentation.
